project_name.justification: The primary project of interest is explicitly named throughout the documents, for example: "Maritime Announces Sale of Lac Pelletier Project to Emperor Metals".

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as Emperor Metals Inc. The text states: "Emperor Metals Inc.(CSE: AUOZ) (the "Company" or "Emperor Metals") - is pleased to announce that it has entered into a property purchase agreement dated January 7, 2025 (the "Property Purchase Agreement") with Maritime Resources Corp. ("Maritime") and its affiliate to acquire all of Maritime's undersurface rights and interests in the Lac Pelletier Property, Quebec".

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Emperor Metals Inc., is identified in the press releases. "s/ "John Florek" John Florek, Chief Executive Officer".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Emperor Metals acquired all of Maritime's interest in the project. The text states Maritime "has sold the 25 mineral claims and one (1) mining lease that form Maritime's interest in the Project".

primary_commodity.justification: The project is consistently referred to as a gold project. For example: "Maritime Announces Sale of Lac Pelletier gold project".

verified_article_link.justification: The article titled "Maritime Announces Sale of Lac Pelletier Project to Emperor Metals" is directly about the specified project and transaction between Maritime Resources Corp. and Emperor Metals Inc.

currency.justification: A deemed share price is given in dollars: "at a deemed price of $0.07 per share". As both the buyer (Emperor Metals Inc., CSE) and seller (Maritime Resources Corp., TSXV) are Canadian companies listed on Canadian exchanges, the currency is inferred to be Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction consideration was entirely in shares. The text states the project was sold "in exchange for an aggregate of 12,500,000 common shares in the capital of Emperor".

share_payments_raw.justification: As per the data extraction hierarchy, since the number of shares and a price per share are provided, `amount_of_shares_issued` and `issued_share_price` are populated instead of this field.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: As per the data extraction hierarchy, since the number of shares and a price per share are provided, `amount_of_shares_issued` and `issued_share_price` are populated instead of this field.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The consideration for the project was 12.5 million shares of the buyer. "Maritime, through its wholly owned subsidiary 2823988 Ontario Corp., has agreed to sell the 25 mineral claims and a mining lease that form Maritime's interest in the Lac Pelletier project (Figure 1) in return for 12.5 million shares of Emperor".

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction consideration.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: A press release from the seller specifies the deemed value of the shares issued as part of the transaction. "in exchange for an aggregate of 12,500,000 common shares in the capital of Emperor (the "Emperor Shares") at a deemed price of $0.07 per share".

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The transaction terms do not include any commitment for a specific amount of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not include any commitment for exploration expenditures.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The text states "The Property is subject to a one percent (1.0%) net smelter returns royalty reserved to Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. pursuant to an underlying royalty agreement." This is a pre-existing royalty held by a third party and was not acquired or retained as part of the transaction between Maritime and Emperor.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The total area of the property is specified in the text: "The Lac Pelletier Property comprises 25 mining claims and a mining lease covering a total area of at least 558 hectares".

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified in the text: "The Lac Pelletier Property comprises 25 mining claims and a mining lease covering a total area of at least 558 hectares".

resource_size.justification: A historical resource estimate is provided for the property: "The Lac Pelletier Property currently has an historical estimated mineral resource of 681,200 tonnes grading @ 4.08 g/t Au for 89,400 oz (total Measured and Indicated), and Inferred mineral resources of 1,099,000 tonnes grading @ 3.89 g/t Au for 137,600 oz Au (see Maritime's press release dated May 11, 2022 as posted on SEDAR+)."

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer, Emperor Metals Inc., is identified with its ticker and exchange: "Emperor Metals Inc. (CSE: AUOZ) ("Emperor")".
